page0.text:
"Fhhn..."
The moment Saber goes flying, I fire at Berserker.
This won't hurt him.
But it should at least get his attention!
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-10:page0:1

page1.text:
"Gh—!?"
The arrow hits Berserker squarely on the temple, but it doesn't even leave a scratch.
I can't even get his attention.
The giant does not block the arrow... He doesn't even seem to care.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-10:page1:1

page2.text:
"That's right, Berserker, leave Shirou alone.
You can do whatever you want with him after you kill Saber."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-10:page2:1

page3.text:
Illya's laugh echoes through the forest.
"D...damn...!"
I can't do anything.
Saber's about to collapse right in front of me, but I can't do anything.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-10:page3:1

page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-10:page4:1
